description: Prepare an unpaid /v1/announcements/latest request and check matching data. Returns count and x402 requirements, never paid records. Latest Binance announcements and new listings with AI sentiment scores.

limit.description: Maximum records to return, 1 to 100. Default 50.

since.description: Optional UTC time such as 2026-11-13T09:00:00Z: only records first seen after it, so a bot polling every hour pays for new items only.

name: quote_getLatestAnnouncements
